knowledge.title: Privileged Account
knowledge.description: The alert involves the privileged account 'administrator'.

knowledge.title: High Severity
knowledge.description: The alert has been classified as High.

recommendations.action: Verify whether activity involving the privileged account is legitimate.
Confirm that multi-factor authentication is enabled for the privileged account.
Review authentication logs for repeated failed login attempts and related source addresses.
Escalate the alert for immediate analyst investigation.
Consider containment if malicious activity is confirmed.

narrative: The alert has been classified as High severity. The confidence in this assessment is High (80%). Mapped MITRE ATT&CK techniques include T1110 (Brute Force).
